mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the mucus was most worthwhile because the resulting cutaway brought the exchanges together: water recovery, microbial products entering cells and blood, and the mucus barrier.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the fermenting contents in the body was clear but added little explanation on its own; the significance of the products remained unclear until the next result.

surprise.text: I learned that colon cells can use some small molecules made by microbes and that some also enter the blood.

arbitrary.text: No action felt entirely arbitrary, though combining mucus with the body triggered several exchanges at once, so it was not obvious beforehand why that single fitting would complete the goal.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it similarly connects a familiar body function to an unexpected cellular relationship. This chapter's final explanation made the assembly more meaningful.
